messages:
Sam (AE): Hey @Marta, kicking off the Stormbridge POC thread — they want a drop-in replacement for their current vendor. Key asks: prompt/response parity, enterprise SSO, KMS, and a pricing comparison (per-token vs reserved). Can SE + Sec weigh in?

Ravi (SE): Thanks — quick summary of their stack: they call a single /v1/generate-like endpoint today, ~500k tokens/day, lots of short prompts (avg 60 tokens). Major concern: output deltas, retry behavior, and how we bill partial tokens.

Marta (Stormbridge Eng): Confirmed. Also they rely on a small set of deterministic prompts for compliance, so any output variance is a blocker. They want a preflight smoke that runs 2k representative prompts for parity metrics.

Ravi (SE): Proposed plan: 1) Provide an adapter example that maps their generate -> Redwood /responses with minimal changes. 2) Run a parity eval harness (we can use our eval infra) with metrics: exact-match, token diff, and semantic similarity. 3) Validate fallback routing (e.g., route to smaller quantized model when Dedicated capacity saturated) and observe latency differences.

Ravi (SE): Example shim we can share:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"input": "{{user_prompt}}", "model": "redwood-1.1"}'
```
(Adjustable to mirror their current body)

Marta (Stormbridge Eng): Nice. Two security items from our side: 1) KMS/BYOK — they need control of keys for customer data. 2) SSO + SCIM provisioning. Are those in scope for Private or Dedicated only?

Leo (Security): Short answers: KMS/BYOK — yes, supported on Private and Dedicated via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure KeyVault). We do server-side envelope encryption; HSM-backed customer-managed keys can be discussed (enterprise add-on). SSO/SCIM — supported (SAML OIDC + SCIM) for enterprise console.

Leo (Security): We'll need Stormbridge to complete our short security intake and send their vendor questionnaire back; I can prefill common answers. Also flag: they asked about audit logs for prompt inputs — we need to confirm retention policy (default logs masked after 90d unless configured).

Sam (AE): @Ana can you provide a quick pricing sketch we can share with the prospect? They asked for both a per-token comparison (current vendor charges aggressive egress/embedding rates) and a reserved tier for 6/12 month commit.

Ana (Pricing): Rough sketch: Hosted per-token: $0.006 / 1k tokens (generation tier) with embedding add-ons. Dedicated reserved capacity (GPU pool): baseline commit $40k/month for their volume with predictable latency and lower per-token compute estimate; discounts scale with 12mo commit. We can model their current spend if they share last 3 months invoices.

Ana (Pricing): Also note: there’s a small onboarding fee for Private deployments (networking + config), and KMS/BYOK support may have a professional service required for key rotation automation.

Marta (Stormbridge Eng): For acceptance criteria from the engineering side:
- Parity run: 2k prompts -> >=95% semantic similarity, <=5% token-level billing delta on average.
- Deterministic suite: all golden prompts must match exactly.
- Latency p95 under committed SLA (250ms target for short prompts) on Dedicated.
- Fallback behaviour: under load, fallback must not return 5xx and must be logged for audit.

Ravi (SE): We'll template the parity harness and include instructions to run locally and in our sandbox. Suggest we run an initial smoke with 200 prompts within 48h, then full 2k set during the engineering POC week.

Sam (AE): Marta — I'll ask them to share the 2k seed set and their last 30 days token breakdown. Also I'll get the legal security questionnaire.

Leo (Security): I'll send the prefilled questionnaire and call out items that need legal signoff (BYOK SLA, log retention beyond default).

deploy-bot: deployment redwood/sandbox: infra up — sandbox for stormbridge-poc available at https://staging.redwood.ai/stormbridge (ops id 4921).

Marta (Stormbridge Eng): Great — can you also confirm network egress IPs? Their security team requires allowlisting.

Ravi (SE): Ops: add a note to the runbook: staging IPs are 35.201.12.34, 35.201.12.35. We'll send the CIDR block and ephemeral ranges for Dedicated.

Ana (Pricing): Next steps: I'll prepare 2 price scenarios (self-serve hosted vs 12mo Dedicated commit) and include estimated savings if they adopt intelligent batching + prefix caching.

Sam (AE): I'll schedule a 30m sync with Stormbridge + SE + Sec tomorrow 10am PT. Agenda: parity scope, security Qs, and pricing options.

Marta (Stormbridge Eng): Thx — bringing their infra lead. If we can get the parity harness + shim today, they can start smoke tests tonight.

Ravi (SE): I'll drop the adapter repo link and a quick runbook after this thread. :thumbsup:

Sam (AE): Awesome — marking this in CRM as POC: stormbridge-swap-v1. Will update after the sync. :rocket:
